data.name: Jonah
data.gender_notes: Jonah is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yonah, 'dove'. Its root is Hebrew y-w-n-h. The prophet Jonah; the Book of Jonah. Jonah is a Hebrew name meaning “Dove”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jonah expresses “Dove”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jonah total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
